question: Is the 64-64 merge-depth policy result reproducible across training seeds?
insight: Held-out mean 416.0 on 300 games, 89.1 below the seed-52 counterpart; no game reached tile 384. Tracking stayed near 473 points late in training. Mean policy entropy fell from about 1.27 to 0.03 nats, suggesting an almost deterministic policy without a clear late score gain.
